verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published filing deadlines, late penalties, or interest schedules with exact figures. It only lists portal entry points such as 'Annual Renewal or Reinstatement', which name the filings without stating due dates or penalty amounts. The probes show the main sos.state.mn.us reading surface is bot-walled, so no deadline or penalty content was captured.

support.subject: As a founder, the filing deadlines and the penalty and interest schedule for missing them are published with exact figures
